title: Interactive Error Stackmap + Retry Blueprint (Console Prototype)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build an interactive console prototype that combines a visual "stackmap" of error propagation with an inline retry-flow composer. The goal is to let engineers quickly triage failed requests, view error taxonomy and causal path, inspect payloads with redaction controls, and issue controlled retries with adjustable retry heuristics. Deliverables: Figma screens, clickable prototype, engineering handoff spec, and accessibility notes. Primary users: SREs, platform engineers, and customer success during escalations.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable prototype demonstrates: error stackmap (service -> model -> kernel layers) and time-sequenced event trail
Inline payload inspector with redaction toggle and quick-copy for sanitized payloads
Retry composer that lets user set max-retries, jitter/backoff strategy, and choose fallback model variant
Cost/latency estimate shown when configuring retry (token-level cost delta) and clear warnings for customer-facing retries
Design tokens and component specs exported for engineering handoff (buttons, timeline lanes, inspector cards)
Prototype includes annotations for telemetry events and tracing hooks required by runtime team
comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: scoped to console > debug view; agreed to show both model- and infra-level nodes in stackmap. Miguel to prototype interactions.
2026-03-05 - PM feedback (Lena): include a quick-cost indicator for retries; add 'dry run' option so support can preview effects without consuming customer quota.
2026-03-08 - Eng sync (Diego): flagged KV cache visibility as sensitive; suggested we default to summarized cache diffs and provide a link to deeper logs (requires ENG-50112).

2026-03-10 - Design review: consolidated timeline + stackmap to reduce cognitive load; suggested micro-animations for step expansion. Accessibility note: ensure keyboard-only navigation for timeline lane controls.
2026-03-12 - Security review request: ask security to validate payload redaction patterns; PII scrub templates required before enabling 'copy payload' action.

2026-03-14 - Prototype v1 uploaded to Figma. Noted trade-off: showing full request body increases triage speed but raises compliance risk. Decided to add a per-customer policy toggle (requires product approval).
2026-03-15 - Next: finalize retry UX flows, handoff spec for telemetry event names, and coordinate integration test plan with runtime team.
notes: Trade-offs: level of detail in payload inspector vs. compliance; we will show sanitized previews by default and an explicit 'reveal' action with audit logging
Design constraint: must render stackmap for requests with >50 events without performance lag; use virtualization in list rendering
Related goals: improve MTTR for errors by 30% for top-5 error classes; reduce support escalations by enabling safe retries from Console
